journeys.name: what did Sauron do, and why

steps.sees: the match bar, ranked rows, Sauron with a BOT chip
steps.ears: WHEN a viewer opens the leaderboard, the app shall list every account with a link into its desk.
steps.judge: can this reader find the bot they heard about?

steps.sees: Sauron's desk: tiles, the blotter with Close controls on every row, New trade
steps.ears: WHEN a viewer opens another account's desk, the app shall render no write control that will refuse them.
steps.known_gap: dead end 4 — Close / Close this buy render on another member's desk, then fail at the server (app/src/shell/blotter-row.tsx:290; src/server/account-identity-gate.ts:63)
steps.judge: does this reader know what they may do here?

steps.sees: the footer promises 'click a symbol for its fill timeline'; the symbols do not click
steps.ears: WHEN the desk promises an interaction, the app shall have a target for it.

expect.text: click a symbol for its fill timeline

steps.known_gap: dead end 5 — 'click a symbol for its fill timeline' names a retired accordion (app/src/routes/u.$id.index.tsx:92)
steps.judge: can this reader tell what to do next in ten seconds?

steps.sees: every cycle: what the persona wanted, 'N past the guards', what happened
steps.ears: WHEN a viewer reads a bot's decisions, the app shall gloss its own words (intents, guards) where they appear.
steps.judge: does a first-time reader understand 'past the guards'?

steps.sees: the thesis, its markers, and a Subscribe cluster that is disabled
steps.ears: WHEN a control is disabled, the app shall show its reason as visible text, not only in a title.
steps.known_gap: dead end 8 — Thesis Subscribe's reason lives only in title/aria-label, invisible on a phone (app/src/shell/thesis-drawer.tsx:81)
steps.judge: does this reader know why Subscribe is off?

steps.sees: the desk's link row: Overview · Pulse · Heartbeat · Thesis — no Activity
steps.ears: WHEN a viewer is on a desk, the app shall offer that account's activity beside its decisions.
steps.known_gap: dead end 5 — /u/:id has no Activity view; the desk's link row lists Overview · Pulse · Heartbeat · Thesis (app/src/shell/desk-rail.tsx) — 2d adds it
steps.judge: can this reader find what the bot actually did?
